description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git merge scenarios involving renames and modifications. It sets up a repository with specific file contents and performs various merge operations to verify correct behavior of merge-rename logic.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a label and commands to execute.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing (non-existent).

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or contents for equality.
